compatibility: No automatic legacy conversion or schema rewrite. Ordinary schemas remain run6/world4; explicitly diagnostic run7/world5 uses exact component codec and retained artifacts. Legacy diagnostic imports refuse nonmutating and expose original-save recovery. Active/queued/unverified diagnostic crafting save refuses; paid-job support remains gated.
limits: Provisioned diagnostic equipment/tool/power fixtures are not natural or earned gameplay
Virtual input and synthetic UI events are not native OS hardware input
Batch GameView screenshot is unavailable; exact per-phase runtime JSON is retained without synthetic screenshot claims
Disposable Windows restart/lock/fault checks are not hardware powercut or cross-platform certification
Wholly unwritable storage cannot persist a new terminal fact across forced process termination; pending diagnostic death blocks live completion/payout/Title and offers retry
Unexpected home-host replacement failure has best-effort before-image rollback and exposes restore_rollback_failed if host reconstruction fails; required inactive endpoints are staged before mutation
Per-instance storage serialization still requires external coordinator serialization
remaining_gates: Paid crafting payload/validation before normal integration activation
Exact reviewed legacy component conversion and unknown Inspect/paid Overhaul route
Normal wrench/source acquisition and authored content qualification
All-class earned solo home/first-ship route content amendment
Natural long-term survival, topology/ecology qualification and full-game audit closure
not_run: Natural all-class or earned acquisition journey
